primary.evidence: 13 checksum-bound derived inputs, 351 saved prediction/embedding NPZs and score receipts, primary numerical ledger
primary.verified_scope: Direct ARI, NMI, secondary-label and gate/edge metrics; no retraining or reclustering

transfer.evidence: 45 retained source/target embedding files, 5 source-only transforms, 30 weight files, 90 target score rows
transfer.verified_scope: Source/target disjointness, frozen transforms and weights, nearest-source-centroid predictions and metrics; no encoder or PCA fitting

scale_controls.evidence: 1170 original score rows, receipts, recovered exact producer, checksum-bound primary PCA inputs
scale_controls.verified_scope: All score and summary arithmetic and patient-excluded nested configuration selection
scale_controls.unverified_scope: Historical control partitions were not saved; direct per-configuration ARI replay would require new clustering fits

her2st_and_extension.evidence: Original protocols, producers, receipts, 720 HER2 primary grid scores, external and extension result tables, retained hardening seed-1 partitions for 3 target definitions
her2st_and_extension.verified_scope: Hash/source/receipt bindings, patient-excluded selections, means and contrasts; 120 seed-1 partition ARIs reconstructed directly
her2st_and_extension.missing_central_inputs: Learned embeddings/gates and remaining seed partitions were not retained by historical HER2ST/extension producers. Direct ARI/AUROC reconstruction for those blocks is unavailable without a new fit; raw sources are checksum-bound and excluded from the archive

whole_section_and_geometry_null.evidence: Original 108 whole-section and 39 geometry-null score rows, summaries, receipts, recovered exact producers and whole-input metadata/selection records
whole_section_and_geometry_null.verified_scope: Saved table/summary arithmetic and exact producer availability
whole_section_and_geometry_null.missing_central_inputs: Historical fitted embeddings/predictions were not retained. The large whole-section expression-derived input NPZs are intentionally excluded; their exact hashes and source records remain available

crc_pilot.evidence: Immutable protocol and pre-data lock, QC annotation amendment and lock, 3 compact PCA inputs and images, 36 saved fitted embeddings/gates and receipts, primary and sensitivity partitions, unique-edge scores and shuffle tables
crc_pilot.verified_scope: 72 ARIs, 18 unique-edge AUROCs, patient bootstrap, and 180 independently recomputed shuffled-label AUROCs from saved evidence; no new model or clustering fit
crc_pilot.unverified_scope: The package verification does not claim to check excluded raw archive contents or author-specific historical backup/integration directories

full_refit.scope: Distinct from saved-result verification; fresh outputs and exact source manifests required. Current and historical runtime versions differ. CUDA fitting was not bitwise deterministic. No download, research fit, new scientific experiment or manuscript number was generated during closure. The unchanged encoder-equivalence unit test fits only synthetic in-memory inputs.
